requirements.title: The seven labels, in one table
requirements.rationale: One source of label names stops the subscribe step from creating names that the worker, the cleanup or the poll do not use.

criteria.action: define exactly seven labels in this order, each with a suffix, a kind, a colour of six lowercase hex digits without '#', and a description: triage (request, 0e8a16, "Ask agent-fox to triage this issue"), fix (request, 0e8a16, "Ask agent-fox to fix this issue"), in-progress (status, fbca04, "agent-fox is working on this issue"), ready (status, 1d76db, "Triaged: the diagnosis is in the body"), needs-human (status, d93f0b, "agent-fox stopped with a question; see the last comment"), landed (status, 0e8a16, "A branch and a pull request (or a carry patch) exist"), failed (status, b60205, "agent-fox could not finish; see the last comment")

steps.action: sends PUT /api/v1/workspaces/widgets with a hub_token and label_prefix af:
validates the body and checks the token with Hub.Workspace and Hub.User
asks hub, through the hub client, to create the seven af: labels one at a time in label table order
stores each label for the slug and answers 201 (or 200 for one it already holds)
logs one INFO record with the created and existing counts, stores the subscription and answers 201 with the view

setup: the real API server, hub client, store and the fake hub granting widgets
end_state: the first answer is 201 with the view and the second 200
the fake hub holds the seven af: labels with table colours and descriptions
one INFO record carries the created and existing counts

execution_paths.title: A person cancels a blocked poll-made fix job and the cleanup puts af:fix back

steps.action: sends POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/cancel for the blocked fix job of issue 42, whose record shows af:needs-human set
cancels the job and marks its cleanup pending in one transaction, then answers with labels.cleanup "pending"
starts a background try that reads the token, the workspace record and issue 42's labels through hub
removes af:needs-human from issue 42 and adds af:fix
records labels {set: [af:fix], removed: [af:needs-human], restore: null, cleanup: done}
sees the cleanup finished with labels.restore null, holds af:fix and creates no job

setup: real jobs layer on a temporary database with fakerunner and fakeclock
real poll supervisor, API server and hub client over the fake hub
a blocked poll fix job of issue 42 with af:needs-human on the issue
end_state: issue 42 ends with af:fix and no status label
the job shows {set:['af:fix'], removed:['af:needs-human'], restore:null, cleanup:'done'}
the next poll cycles create no job and remove nothing

execution_paths.title: A runner is cancelled before it reports a hub session

steps.action: cancels the job of issue 42 while its second attempt runs in the fake runner
observes the cancel before reporting a hub session and returns
records the cancelled attempt with no hub session and marks the cleanup pending in the same transaction
starts the try once no runner of the job is in progress
removes af:needs-human from issue 42 and adds af:fix

setup: real jobs layer with fakerunner.Do and fakeclock
real hub client and fake hub
a blocked poll fix job of issue 42 answered so the second attempt runs
end_state: the cancelled attempt is recorded and labels.cleanup is 'pending'
after the runner is no longer in progress, issue 42 carries af:fix and no af:needs-human

execution_paths.title: A cleanup that meets an unavailable hub is retried by the sweep

steps.action: cancels a blocked fix job of issue 42
answers 503 to the label write
keeps labels.cleanup "pending" and labels.restore "af:fix", and logs one WARN record
on the sweep one minute later by the fake clock, starts another try in the background
accepts the label writes, and the jobs layer records labels.cleanup "done"

setup: real jobs layer with fakeclock and fake hub answering 503 to the label write
captured logs
a blocked fix job of issue 42
end_state: labels.cleanup stays 'pending' with labels.restore 'af:fix' and one WARN logged
after the sweep the cleanup is 'done' and issue 42 carries af:fix and no af:needs-human

execution_paths.title: An unsubscribe cleans up its blocked job before removing the subscription

steps.action: sends DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/widgets while a poll-made fix job of issue 42 is blocked
cancels the job, marks its cleanup pending and starts its first try
removes af:needs-human from issue 42 and adds af:fix
records labels.cleanup "done", then removes the subscription and its token
answers the DELETE

a blocked poll fix job of issue 42 with af:needs-human on the issue
real jobs layer, hub client and fake hub
end_state: before the subscription row is removed, issue 42 carries af:fix and no af:needs-human
